label: directed communication to
definition: X communicates a request, message, advice, testimony or information to addressee Y.
scope_notes: Preserves directed communication scope: explicit tell, ask, urge, advise, notify or send-message constructions qualify. Co-occurrence, criticism without address, marriage and support alone do not.

facts.reason: Greenspan tells, testifies to, urges and advises Congress.
Administration explicitly asks, tells, notifies, submits to and urges Congress.
Mr. Kerry explicitly tells Teresa Heinz Kerry; the wife-related rows alone are a different relation.
Republicans explicitly urge Mr. Clinton; accusations and criticism are not independently treated as communication to him.
White House explicitly asks, urges, tells and notifies Congress.
